insight: HAPI web tests must run from web/ package root (cd web && bunx vitest run ...), not from repo root. Running from root causes 'Cannot find package @/chat/normalize' and picks up worktree files.

When two async operations (fetchLatestMessages vs refreshMessagesAfterRewind) can race on the same external store, use a per-session refreshGeneration counter. Capture generation before async, return prev on mismatch. Prevents stale responses from corrupting newer state.

When using Edit tool to add a new test, ensure the old_string uniquely matches the closing boundary. Using too broad old_string can accidentally replace an existing test instead of inserting after it. Always verify the file after edit.

Web rewind refresh uses replace-not-merge: refreshMessagesAfterRewind keeps old messages visible during loading, then replaces entire visible window with server response. Clear pending on success. Fallback to clearMessageWindow only when api is unavailable (SSE without api prop).
Code review via Agent with isolation:worktree cannot see uncommitted changes in the main workspace, making review useless for in-progress work. Use direct git diff in current workspace instead.
Never pass Read.pages for non-PDF files. The tool rejects empty strings and single-page values for non-PDF. Always omit the pages parameter entirely for regular files.
